model: The component's state, from its `init`; keep it in your model
toParentMessage: Wraps the component's messages in your own message type
onClick: Message sent when it is clicked
onChange: Builds the message sent when the value changes
href: Renders a link to this address
label: Accessible name, when there is no visible text
order: The order of the parts inside, by name
renderRoot: Renders the root element yourself, given its attributes and children
